pr_metadata.title: feat: Labels for encrypted fields
pr_metadata.description:
### SUMMARY
This PR adds labels to `encrypted_extra_sensitive_fields`. This is needed to implement support for export/import including `masked_encrypted_extra` (https://github.com/apache/superset/pull/38077 and https://github.com/apache/superset/pull/38078).

### BEFORE/AFTER SCREENSHOTS OR ANIMATED GIF
No UI changes.

### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS
N/A

gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added `encrypted_extra_sensitive_field_labels` dictionary must be present without corresponding logic to derive labels from `encrypted_extra_sensitive_fields` or unify them.
gold_comments.rationale: Maintaining two separate fields (`encrypted_extra_sensitive_fields` and `encrypted_extra_sensitive_field_labels`) risks inconsistency if keys are not kept in sync, increasing maintenance burden and potential bugs.
